The '''EMRG-50 Rail Gun''' was an [[Arachnoid]] built [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]]. It boasted a magazine of four shots, and had a minimum range of a hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and a maximum range of four thousand meters. However, the weapon had a single severe drawback; recoil. The EMRG-50 boasted such a high recoil that it was all but unusable by sentients without a strength factor nearly double that of a standard human. The Arachnoid [[Ptak-Sok]] owned a EMRG-50 during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
